Abstract

A LIDAR device may transmit light pulses originating from one or more light sources .

Description

BACKGROUND
Vehicles can be configured to operate in an autonomous mode .
One such sensor is a light detection and ranging ( LIDAR ) device .

Claims ( 3 )

What is claimed is:
1. A light detection and ranging (LIDAR) device, comprising:
a lens mounted to a housing ; and
a plurality of light sources .
2. The LIDAR device of claim 1 , wherein the lens is curved.
3. A method comprising: rotating a housing.
